title: Entity growth batch 03 — group A
notes: Breadth-first candidate group for Issue #199. Canonical publication prohibited until candidate validation and manual review complete.

entities.summary: Self-custody cryptocurrency wallet built directly into the Brave browser across supported desktop and mobile platforms.
entities.notes: Current first-party Brave material establishes Brave Wallet as a self-custody wallet built into Brave rather than a third-party extension. Initial launch date remains unresolved in this breadth pass.

entities.summary: Non-custodial Crypto.com wallet ecosystem formerly branded Crypto.com DeFi Wallet and rebranded to Crypto.com Onchain in 2024.
entities.notes: First-party material explicitly preserves Crypto.com DeFi Wallet continuity into the Crypto.com Onchain rebrand on 2024-11-20. The rebrand date is not treated as the original wallet launch date.

entities.summary: Self-custodial wallet ecosystem from Binance, originally launched as Binance Web3 Wallet and later rebranded to Binance Wallet.
entities.notes: Current Binance first-party material states that Binance Wallet is self-custodial and was originally launched as Binance Web3 Wallet before a December 2024 rebrand. Initial launch date is intentionally left unresolved in this pass.

entities.summary: Self-custodial cryptocurrency wallet application published by Bitcoin.com for managing supported digital assets.
entities.notes: Current Bitcoin.com support and legal material explicitly states that the wallet is self-custodial and Bitcoin.com does not take custody of wallet assets. Initial wallet launch date remains unresolved.

entities.summary: Open-source self-custody cryptocurrency wallet from BitPay, available on mobile and desktop platforms.
entities.notes: Current first-party BitPay material explicitly describes BitPay Wallet as self-custody and available across iOS, Android and desktop. The company's 2011 founding date is not reused as the wallet launch date.

products.summary: Brave browser-native self-custody wallet surface available within supported Brave desktop and mobile browsers.
products.notes: Modeled as one browser-integrated wallet product rather than a browser extension because Brave explicitly states no extension is required. Initial release date remains unresolved.

products.summary: Current Crypto.com Onchain browser extension for non-custodial multichain wallet management.
products.notes: Selected as the breadth-pass product boundary. Mobile and other Onchain wallet surfaces are distinct distribution/runtime products and are deferred. The 2025 extension revamp is not treated as the original extension launch.

products.summary: Self-custodial Binance Wallet mobile surface integrated into the Binance application.
products.notes: Selected mobile boundary only. Binance's current web wallet has a separate desktop/on-chain-trading architecture and is deferred. December 2024 is rebrand chronology rather than original product launch.

products.summary: Bitcoin.com self-custodial mobile wallet application for supported cryptocurrency assets.
products.notes: Current app boundary is established by Bitcoin.com support material. Exact original app launch date remains unresolved.

products.summary: BitPay self-custody wallet application distributed across mobile and desktop operating systems from the same wallet lineage.
products.notes: Treated as one multi-platform application product because current first-party material presents the same BitPay Wallet app and recovery phrase model across mobile and desktop.

evidence.title: Brave Wallet - Secure Crypto Wallet
evidence.notes: Current first-party Brave page identifies Brave Wallet as a self-custody wallet built directly into Brave and available on major devices.

evidence.title: What is Brave Wallet?
evidence.notes: First-party help center confirms browser-native self-custody and desktop/mobile usage.

evidence.title: Introducing Crypto.com Onchain: The New and Improved DeFi Wallet
evidence.notes: First-party announcement explicitly renames Crypto.com DeFi Wallet to Crypto.com Onchain and describes Onchain as non-custodial.

evidence.title: Introducing the New Crypto.com Onchain Extension
evidence.notes: First-party product update confirms the active non-custodial Onchain browser extension and distinguishes mobile and desktop wallet surfaces.

evidence.title: What Is the Binance Wallet and How to Use It?
evidence.notes: Current first-party Binance article describes Binance Wallet as self-custodial, identifies mobile and web versions, and states that it was originally Binance Web3 Wallet before the December 2024 rebrand.

evidence.title: Binance Wallet
evidence.notes: Current first-party Binance wallet landing page used for the selected current mobile wallet boundary; exact original launch date is not inferred.

evidence.title: Wallet Service Terms
evidence.notes: Bitcoin.com wallet terms state that the wallet software permits users to self-custody virtual currency and that Bitcoin.com does not take custody.

evidence.title: Cryptocurrency security
evidence.notes: Current Bitcoin.com support explicitly identifies the Bitcoin.com Wallet app as self-custodial with user-controlled keys.

evidence.title: BitPay Wallet
evidence.notes: Current BitPay wallet page describes the wallet as open source and self-custody with user-controlled keys.

evidence.title: How to create a wallet using the BitPay app
evidence.notes: Current BitPay support confirms self-custody and current iOS, Android, Windows, macOS and Linux distribution.
